programme_facts.value: Employers who wish to employ apprentices are required to complete an approval process.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

programme_facts.value: Register your company's interest in the apprenticeship programme by completing the expression of interest form or by contacting us at apprenticeships@ul.ie.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

programme_facts.value: Complete the UL Approval Process: Site visit by one of the dedicated UL programme managers to assess your suitability to host an apprenticeship. Complete the Company sponsorship paperwork, including the identification of an In-Company Mentor.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

programme_facts.value: Complete the SOLAS approval process: Site visit by an Authorising Officer of the local Education & Training Board. SOLAS approval of the company for funding, including SOLAS paperwork for each apprentice.

metadata.chunk_title: For employers

programme_facts.value: Complete the UL Postgraduate Registration process: UL Graduate & Professional Studies will send the successful applicant the link to proceed through the normal UL postgraduate student application process.
